description: The configuration surface of the valkey chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

auth.description: The credential the operator reads `requirepass` from. Not a tenant-facing setting.

password.description: The requirepass value. Resolved from the tenant's Vault at render time by ISecretResolver; it is never written into a values file or into grain state.
password.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: The value is provisioned into the tenant's Vault and reaches the RedisFailover as a Secret REFERENCE BY NAME (spec.auth.secretPath), never as a value. Declaring it in the resource body would put a plaintext password into grain state — nothing on the write path substitutes a SecretRef before the grain persists the body — which docs/plan/00 § Non-negotiables forbids outright. docs/plan/12 § Cross-cutting decisions, Credentials, puts the value itself behind listKeys.

auth.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: The value is provisioned into the tenant's Vault and reaches the RedisFailover as a Secret REFERENCE BY NAME (spec.auth.secretPath), never as a value. Declaring it in the resource body would put a plaintext password into grain state — nothing on the write path substitutes a SecretRef before the grain persists the body — which docs/plan/00 § Non-negotiables forbids outright. docs/plan/12 § Cross-cutting decisions, Credentials, puts the value itself behind listKeys.

imageName.description: Override the Valkey image. Empty means derive it from `version`, which is what keeps minor upgrades automatic.
imageName.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: A pinned image defeats automatic minor upgrades, so it is a platform escape hatch rather than a tenant setting. ⚠ Leaving it empty must NOT mean "let the operator choose": spotahome's defaultImage is redis:6.2.6-alpine, which is the licence ADR-011 rejected, so the empty case renders a Valkey tag rather than nothing.

maxmemoryPolicy.description: What happens when the cache reaches its memory limit. noeviction returns an error to the writer rather than dropping a key somebody is relying on.

mode.description: Replication topology. Sentinel is the only one this operator implements, and a client written against it is not portable to a sharded deployment, so it may not change after create.

enabled.description: Whether the operator runs a metrics exporter beside every Valkey and every Sentinel pod.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

persistence.description: What survives a restart. None of the three settings makes a cache a database.

class.description: StorageClass name. Empty means the cluster default.

fsync.description: How often the append-only file reaches the disk. Read only when the mode is AOF; everysec can lose the last second of writes.

mode.description: None keeps nothing, RDB snapshots periodically, AOF appends every write.

size.description: Persistent volume size in Kubernetes quantity form. Unused when the mode is None, which keeps the data directory in memory.

platform.description: Resource identity injected by the reconciler. Not a tenant-facing setting.

apiVersion.description: The api-version the resource was last written at, rendered into the cybercloud.io/api-version label.
apiVersion.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

managedBy.description: Value of the cybercloud.io/managed-by label. Constant, and the selector every informer filters on.
managedBy.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceGroup.description: Resource group name, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-group label.
resourceGroup.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceId.description: Resource GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-id label.
resourceId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceType.description: Fully qualified resource type, rendered into the cybercloud.io/resource-type label.
resourceType.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/subscription-id label.
subscriptionId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

tenantId.description: Tenant GUID, rendered into the cybercloud.io/tenant-id label.
tenantId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

platform.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

replicas.description: Number of Valkey instances, including the primary. One is a single point of failure and is offered for development only.

sizing.description: CPU and memory, either by preset or explicitly.

cpu.description: Explicit vCPU quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 500m or 2. Empty means take it from the preset.

memory.description: Explicit memory quantity in Kubernetes form, for example 4Gi. Empty means take it from the preset. It also sets maxmemory, so a cache evicts or refuses before the kernel kills the pod.

preset.description: A sizing preset from docs/plan/12. Caches use the m1 family, which is 1 vCPU to 8 GiB.

version.description: Major Valkey version. Minor upgrades are applied automatically in the maintenance window.
